articles.title: New research rules out the theory of Stonehenge Altar Stone's Northeast Scottish Origin
articles.description: Researchers continue to explore the origins of the Altar Stone at Stonehenge, which weighs approximately six tonnes. Previous assumptions about the Altar Stone's Welsh origins have been challenged by new geological insights.
